patterns.name: 〜が気になる
patterns.explanation: きになる is a set phrase, literally 'it gets onto my mind', used when something keeps bothering you or catching your attention. きに なる = 'it's on my mind'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives an explaining tone; のよね is the feminine way to say it while asking for agreement. きに なるのよね = 'it bothers me, you know?'
